Variants.Content: The city of Thor is located on the eastern coast of Dorne and is a castle territory facing the Dorne Sea. "Tor" in the local context means capes and tors; sea breeze, salt spray, shallow bays and coastal roads jointly shape this place. It is not as densely networked as the lower reaches of the Green Blood River, nor is it as steep as the Red Mountains, but it must strike a balance between limited fresh water, fisheries, sea routes and wasteland farming. The Dornish Sea brings merchants, Myr ships, and news from distant lands, as well as pirates and storms. Tor's geographical function remains constant: it is an observation and supply point on the east coast of Dorne.

Entry The Tor If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen saw boats, bridges, millstones, fishing nets and riverside churches in the city of Tor. The clergy guarded the common memory of the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry The Tor They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
